264-286 DU ;; Decision table restating api.md semantics and the status sections above (captured as constraints).

C x.consistent-status EX API-003 MUST ;; Keep status-code behaviour consistent across similar endpoints (e.g. one convention for repeated DELETE of an absent resource: 204 or 404, not mixed). ;; = ;; none ;; Consistency obligation not in the oracle.
C api004.empty-success OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; An empty collection is a successful result: 200 [] rather than 204 or 404. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.201-created OL API-003 MUST ;; 201 when the request created a new API resource (PUT may create at a new URI); not merely because a row was inserted. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.202-incomplete OL API-003 MUST ;; 202 when processing was accepted but is not complete when the response is sent. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.202-operation EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; When practical return an operation identifier or Location to observe 202 progress. ;; = ;; When practical. ;; Not in the oracle.
C api003.204-no-body OL API-003 MUST ;; 204 when no body is needed; a 204 response must not contain a body. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-304 EX API-003 MUST ;; 304 only for conditional requests with a still-valid cached representation; never a generic business response. ;; = ;; none ;; Less-common status semantics (EXC-009).
C api005.400-not-auth OL API-005 MUST_NOT ;; 400 covers invalid HTTP requests, not authentication failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.401 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 when authentication is missing or failed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api005.403-and-hiding OL API-005 MUST ;; 403 when authenticated but not allowed; hiding protected resources with 404 must be a deliberate consistent policy. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.404-vs-empty OL API-004,API-005 MUST ;; 404 when the resource does not exist or is deliberately hidden; zero-match collection queries return 200 []. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-406-415 EX API-003 MUST ;; 406 when no acceptable response representation can be produced; 415 for unsupported request media type; do not confuse them. ;; = ;; none ;; Content-negotiation semantics (EXC-009).
C api006.409 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for valid requests conflicting with current state (uniqueness, transitions, concurrent operations, reused idempotency keys); not for malformed syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.412 OL API-006 MUST ;; A false supplied precondition (stale If-Match) is 412, not a generic 409. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-422 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 422 for structurally valid but semantically invalid requests; follow an established 400-for-both convention; new APIs distinguishing them use 400 for contract errors and 422 for semantics. ;; = ;; Established convention. ;; 400/422 distinction not in the oracle.
C x.http-428 EX API-006 MUST ;; 428 when a contract-required precondition is absent; for other preconditions only when the contract defines them. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in API-006.
C x.http-429 EX API-003 MUST ;; 429 for rate-limited requests with Retry-After when known; never represent validation failures as rate limiting. ;; = ;; none ;; Rate-limiting semantics not in the oracle.
C api007.500 OL API-007,API-002,API-008 MUST ;; 500 for unexpected failures with no more specific outcome, handled centrally with ProblemDetails without internal details. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-502-504 EX API-003 MUST_NOT ;; 502/504 only when acting as an intermediary (invalid upstream response / upstream timeout); not for every dependency failure or TaskCanceledException; distinguish own timeouts from upstream ones. ;; = ;; none ;; Gateway status semantics (EXC-009).
C x.http-503 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 503 for temporary inability (maintenance, critical dependency unavailable, chosen overload semantics) with Retry-After when meaningful. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api021.distinguish-cancel OL API-021 MUST ;; Distinguish a client that cancelled the incoming request from timeouts when choosing a response. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.no-false-idempotency OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not claim idempotency merely because duplicate requests are unlikely. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.conditional-semantics OL API-006 MUST ;; When HTTP optimistic concurrency is part of the contract prefer standard conditional semantics (ETag/If-Match/412) and do not replace them with custom status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc010.translate OL ARC-010 MUST ;; Controllers translate Application outcomes into HTTP outcomes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api002.stable-codes OL API-002,FE-009 MUST ;; Machine-readable clients rely on stable error codes/contract fields in ProblemDetails, not human-readable messages. ;; = ;; none ;;
